findings.issue: Post-write _remaining(deadline) runs before classifying/reporting on_write. If the write completes at/beyond deadline, a complete or partial actual write gets no receipt. Report actual write result immediately after bus.write returns, then enforce remaining deadline before feedback. Preserve no-repeat behavior.
findings.requiredTest: FakeSerial write consumes remaining deadline; callback must still observe COMPLETE/PARTIAL/FAILED while exchange fails deadline and actual one write is counted.

findings.issue: Read aliases for admitted_target preserve legacy names even though prompt requested no compatibility wrappers; migrate callers to admitted_target and delete alias properties unless a concrete justified consumer remains.

Incoming submission checks new deadline but does not tick/withdraw a previously admitted expired goal. A new fresh window/target can replace expired active goal while still MOVING without mandatory Stop/check/arm. Run required housekeeping before accepting replacement.
findings.requiredTest: Admit and dispatch goal, advance to exact expiry, issue new window, submit fresh replacement without tick; must withdraw/disarm and reject motion until explicit check/arm.

findings.issue: Calls _now before recording a known actual COMPLETE write. Invalid/regressing clock after successful bus.write can erase actual write evidence and keep logical ARMED. Retain claim timestamp and report actual completion independently of a later invalid clock, fault/Stop without fabricated timestamps.
findings.requiredTest: Prewrite core claim at valid time, bus.write completes but changes core clock to invalid/regressed value; actual full write must remain recorded while no further mode-1 dispatch is permitted.

findings.issue: prepare can replace an in-flight plan and forget its outcome; claim advances next index before dispatch_result so next joint may be claimed while prior result is unresolved. Require one in-flight ordered write and avoid losing it during invalidation.
findings.requiredTest: After claim index0 before result, reject another prepare and index1 claim; resolving full index0 then permits index1. Keep fixed bounded state.
